negative_snippets:
Very Disappointing Experience

I recently stayed at this property and the experience was far below expectations. There was no room service provided, which made the stay quite inconvenient. The ventilation was poor, and the room felt suffocating. The washroom smelled bad and had water leakage, making it uncomfortable to use. Even the jet spray wasn't working properly, which shows a lack of basic maintenance.

Additionally, the hotel has no lift, so carrying luggage to upper floors was a struggle. There is also no parking facility, which adds to the inconvenience for travelers with vehicles.

Overall, considering the location and the price, the hotel is not worth the stay. A lot of improvement is needed.

This place feels more like a rain basera than a hotel.
